concerns.text: FR-001 (and other FRs) reference "US-1" (e.g., "(See US-1)") but the document defines the user stories as "User Story 1" etc. The identifier "US-1" does not exist, causing a broken cross‑reference.
Inconsistent terminology: the narrative uses "User Story 1" while functional requirements use the shorthand "US-1". This unstable naming can lead to confusion and mis‑linking between sections.
